results.market_gap: Potential preparatory review, decision log and notification evidence packaging; exact specialist competitor coverage remains unverified. Kharon has established overlapping diligence buyer and workflow.

results.marketing_strategy: Target US-based cross-border investment lawyers and venture fund compliance leaders; request legal review before selling.
results.first_customer_plan: Interview two US OISP compliance counsel about evidence management gap relative to Kharon and ONS; obtain product/security requirements.
results.main_risk: Legal accuracy, confidential investment data, regulated legal advice boundary, and entrenched Kharon screening capabilities.
results.validation_assumption: A distinct pre-filing evidence workflow exists beyond Kharon and cannot be handled adequately with ONS and existing compliance tooling.
results.local_applicability_rationale: US Treasury law is the jurisdictional trigger; market mainly US persons and their counsel, not a Turkish local solution.
results.review_notes: No directly equivalent end-to-end OISP pre-filing evidence desk confirmed in scoped searches; Kharon is near-substitute. results.canonical_news_title: How generative AI can help scientists synthesize complex materials

global_competitors.name: SciNote
global_competitors.reason: Laboratory teams can version experimental protocols, execute stepwise recipes, record deviations/results, use structured batch forms and maintain audit trails; substantial same-buyer same-job same-workflow overlap.

adjacent_competitors.name: Labguru
adjacent_competitors.reason: Additional lab experiment workflow overlap; exact direct status not independently rechecked in this pass.

competition_search_terms: laboratory recipe version control protocol handoff ELN
scientific experiment protocol batch record audit trail SciNote
Türkiye laboratuvar deney protokolü yönetimi ELN
results.market_gap: No defensible standalone gap demonstrated against SciNote's protocol, batch, and result workflow.
results.mvp: Versioned recipe register, experiment batch cards, deviation log, reviewer signoff, CSV export.
results.working_logic: Import or enter recipe -> freeze version -> execute batch checklist -> record deviations/results -> review and export.
results.marketing_strategy: Direct outreach to R&D laboratory managers; not recommended absent niche differentiation.
results.first_customer_plan: Identify one materials lab workflow that SciNote demonstrably cannot cover; not yet found.
results.main_risk: Established direct competitor already solves substantially the same core job.
results.validation_assumption: No unique narrow materials synthesis handoff requirement has been evidenced.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Global scope candidate; no Lüleburgaz claim.
results.rejection_reason: SciNote provides versioned executable protocols, batch/forms records and traceability for the same laboratory buyer; standalone differentiated market gap unproven. The MIT triggering article is from February, not October 2026.
results.review_notes: Rejection is based on a sufficient confirmed global direct competitor and absence of demonstrated differentiation; unverified cost and Turkish competition do not need invented values.

results.market_gap: No differentiated field intake and task workflow shown against Turkish and global direct competitors.

results.local_applicability_rationale: Trakya transferability remains a hypothesis; no specific Lüleburgaz buyer footprint verified.
results.rejection_reason: Same buyer and core field visit/photo/task follow-up workflow already served by Çiftçi Takip and AgroSaha in Türkiye and Myca globally. No proven niche differentiation.
results.review_notes: A competition-based rejection does not claim a zero-cost MVP or verified local scope.
